one_line_answer.text: After finding skill and knowledge gaps, the trainer develops a technical competency development plan. It details the additional skills or competencies to be acquired.

cites.quote: After identifying the skill and knowledge gaps the TVET teachers/trainers need to develop technical competency development planner.
This planner will include all the detail about the additional skills or competencies to be acquired.

bangla_explanation: Skill আর knowledge gaps পাওয়ার পর trainer নিজের জন্য একটা technical competency development plan বানান।
Plan-এ থাকে learning outcomes, evidence আর training strategies (location, duration, cost)।
Plan যেন realistic আর achievable হয়, তাই Principal-এর সাথে consult করতে হয়।
Approval পেলে trainer Off The Job বা On The Job training-এ অংশ নেন।
শেষে industry specialist-কে one direct আর two indirect evidences দেখিয়ে competency প্রমাণ করতে হয়।

example.en: A welding instructor plans a course and an industry attachment. His principal approves the plan. He then joins the training.
example.bn: Plan লিখুন, principal-এর approval নিন, তারপর training-এ যান।

short.prompt: What are the steps in developing a personal training plan for technical competency?
short.modelAnswer:
A technical competency development plan is made after finding skill and knowledge gaps.
1. Identify learning outcomes required to achieve competencies.
2. Identify evidence requirements to prove competency.
3. Identify learning/training strategies: location, duration and cost.
4. Gain relevant approval to undertake training.
5. Participate in own technical upskilling program.
Consult the Principal/Supervisor so the plan is realistic and achievable.

cites.quote: all the learning outcomes are derived from the elements of different unit of competencies.

keyPoints.text: After approval, the trainer starts the up-skilling course or industry attachment.

cites.quote: After getting the approval from the authority the teacher/trainer can now start the up-skilling training course or participate in the industry attachment program as described in the plan.

checks.note: Approving authority differs inside CBLM 7 (cblm07-sc1-q4). Information sheet p.17: 'the Principal and the higher authority'. Answer key p.21: 'Principal/ Supervisor of the institution or Designated Authority of BTEB'. The sample planner on p.15 (outside this pack) shows 'Approved by Principal/ Supervisor' and 'Approved by Agency ... BMET'. The card teaches Principal/Supervisor plus a higher authority and quotes the BTEB answer key. Owner to confirm whether learners should write BTEB.
